The '''FD-011 crossbow''' was a weapon sometimes used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Behind the scenes==
This is the weapon used by Chewbacca in the ''[[Super Star Wars]]'' video game, and looks like his usual [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]].
